WITH player_keys AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches
    FROM main.player
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT
    TYPEOF(b.g) AS games_type,
    TYPEOF(b.r) AS runs_type,
    TYPEOF(b.h) AS hits_type,
    TYPEOF(b.hr) AS home_runs_type,
    COUNT(*) AS batting_rows,
    MIN(b.g) AS min_games, MAX(b.g) AS max_games,
    MIN(b.r) AS min_runs, MAX(b.r) AS max_runs,
    MIN(b.h) AS min_hits, MAX(b.h) AS max_hits,
    MIN(b.hr) AS min_home_runs, MAX(b.hr) AS max_home_runs,
    MIN(COALESCE(p.matches, 0)) AS min_player_matches,
    MAX(COALESCE(p.matches, 0)) AS max_player_matches
FROM main.batting AS b
LEFT JOIN player_keys AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
GROUP BY TYPEOF(b.g), TYPEOF(b.r), TYPEOF(b.h), TYPEOF(b.hr)

arguments.sql:
WITH player_stint_highs AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        MAX(g) AS games_played,
        MAX(NULLIF(r, '')) AS runs,
        MAX(NULLIF(h, '')) AS hits,
        MAX(NULLIF(hr, '')) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting
    GROUP BY player_id
),
scores (player_id, stat_order, statistic, score) AS (
    SELECT player_id, 1, 'Games played', games_played FROM player_stint_highs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, 2, 'Runs', runs FROM player_stint_highs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, 3, 'Hits', hits FROM player_stint_highs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, 4, 'Home runs', home_runs FROM player_stint_highs
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT scores.*, MAX(score) OVER (PARTITION BY statistic) AS record_score
    FROM scores
)
SELECT r.statistic, p.name_given, r.score
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE r.score = r.record_score
ORDER BY r.stat_order, p.name_given
LIMIT -1
